description: Election Commission - R. Lalithavathy was Selected as the Member of the Valikamam South Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Valikamam South Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with the electoral process for local authorities, including the resignation of a member and the nomination of a replacement by a recognized political party. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7) which cover electoral processes, candidate nominations, and declarations related to local authority elections.
